methodology.interactions: Production adapters; ten samples, twenty for selection; upstream warmups (partial update 3, others 5); no sample trimming. Total includes rendering. Partial update, selection and swap use 4x CPU slowdown; creation unthrottled.
methodology.memory: Three samples each; upstream forced GC and performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory; MiB; no eager-measurement flag. Page memory, not JS heap alone.
methodology.limitations: Fixed order on one local machine; no concurrent benchmark/build/test jobs, but system noise uncontrolled. Not an official submission or general library ranking.
methodology.controls: Elements fresh disables only row vnode reuse. React fresh removes only Row memoization and retains header memoization. Both Elements variants use one application observer.
methodology.validation: All four adapters passed keyed create/remove/swap checks; interaction and memory runs completed with successful plausibility checks; diagnostic assertions passed.
methodology.startup: Pinned Lighthouse worker called directly because general runner assigns STARTUP_MAIN zero iterations; three fresh-browser samples per framework, default simulated mobile throttling. Initial shutdown-port-race attempt discarded; complete run uses distinct ports.
methodology.hashes: Captured with report; measured runtime and fixtures unchanged. Diagnostics runner gained source-hash metadata after its measured runs.

diagnostics.methodology: Synchronous JS and DOM only; 5 warmups, 15 samples, no CPU throttling. Fresh page per case.

profile.methodology: Synchronous JS and DOM only; 5 warmups, 15 samples, no CPU throttling. Fresh page per case.

startup.methodology: Pinned harness Lighthouse implementation and defaults; three fresh-browser runs per framework; no warmups.
